title: Mystic Eye Sorceress
description: A stylized black-skinned female figure with white braided hair stands centrally, holding a glowing green spiral orb in her left hand while extending her right. Above her head floats a large stylized eye containing a green cosmic spiral galaxy, with white smoke-like energy flowing from the eye into her head. The scene is surrounded by purple flowers, green leaves, and multiple smaller swirling galaxy orbs.
prompt: A surreal symbolic illustration on black background featuring a graceful black-skinned woman with intricate white braids, wearing a form-fitting black outfit. She holds a glowing green spiral orb with white dots in one hand while reaching toward floating cosmic orbs. A giant stylized eye with long lashes floats above her, filled with a swirling green galaxy and stars, with white ethereal energy flowing downward into her head. Purple flowers and green foliage frame the bottom. High contrast, intricate line work, mystical atmosphere.
